criterion: Writes a plan document under docs/plans/ (active or completed/) describing the hierarchical org/project quota model and atomic reservation flow.
Checks both project quota and parent organization quota before consuming capacity in tenantquota/enforcer.py, ensuring neither counter is incremented if either limit would be exceeded.
Provides a release/refund mechanism that returns consumed units to both the project and parent organization pools without dropping below zero.
Adds unit tests under tests/ covering project-limit rejection, org-pool exhaustion across sibling projects, atomic non-mutation on failure, and capacity release.
All unit tests in tests/ pass when run with python3 -m unittest discover -s tests.
